FROM v_atom, v_bond, v_connected
final_sql:
SELECT MAX(COUNT(bond_type)) AS most_common_bond_type
FROM (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id AS molecule_id, bond.bond_type AS bond_type
    FROM v_atom
    LEFT JOIN v_bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bond.molecule_id AS molecule_id, bond.bond_type AS bond_type
    FROM v_connected
    LEFT JOIN v_bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
) AS bonded_atoms
GROUP BY bond.molecule_id, bond.bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH account AS (
    SELECT account.account_id AS account_number,
           AVG(loan.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account AS account ON l.account_id = account.account_id
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
client_gender AS (
    SELECT client.gender AS gender,
           MIN(birth_date) AS oldest_birthdate
    FROM client c
    LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
),
loan_by_gender AS (
    SELECT account.account_id AS account_number,
           AVG(loan.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account AS account ON l.account_id = account.account_id
    LEFT JOIN client_gender cg ON l.account_id = cg.account_id
    GROUP BY l.account_id, cg.gender
),
avg_salary_by_gender AS (
    SELECT gender, AVG(loan.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM loan_by_gender
    GROUP BY gender
),
highest_avg AS (
    SELECT gender, MAX(avg_salary) AS highest_avg
    FROM avg_salary_by_gender
    GROUP BY gender
),
lowest_avg AS (
    SELECT gender, MIN(avg_salary) AS lowest_avg
    FROM avg_salary_by_gender
    GROUP BY gender
),
gap_calc AS (
    SELECT h.gender AS person_gender,
           h.highest_avg - l.lowest_avg AS gap
    FROM highest_avg h
    JOIN lowest_avg l ON h.gender = l.gender
)
SELECT account_number, gap
FROM gap_calc
WHERE gap > 0
ORDER BY gap DESC
